title: Fixed three-return online direct-Picard descriptive diagnostic

governance.current_effect: This file defines a possible future descriptive experiment but authorizes no implementation or process.
future_execution_prerequisites: A separately reviewed governance amendment must explicitly set amends_prior_execution_prohibition=true while keeping supersedes_prior_result=false.
A separate implementation freeze must bind the exact three-block deck, parser, checker, executable, inputs and total wall-clock safety limit.

scientific_object.description: Exactly x0->x1->x2->x3 in one isolated process; do not evaluate G_h_legacy32(x3).
scientific_object.purpose: Describe two adjacent finite-trajectory relations for each state component and test whether three valid online returns can be completed.

frozen_map.leakage_feedback: L_current enters every radial plane and L_next is written only after a valid returned axial solve

initial_state_construction.snapshots: read frozen initial_snapshots.xsm and reconstruct L0 once with SPOLEAK from the frozen axial state

future_map_block: SPOPROJ FIXB reconstructs B*a_current into the plane archive.
SpotPlaneFS constructs frozen F*phi_current/k_current with SPOFSRC.
SpotPlaneFS assembles the leakage-coupled radial system.
SpotPlaneFS performs an online TYPE S radial FLU solve and SPOFCHK.
ASM SPOD FIXB rebuilds the current radial response without changing the basis.
Axial FLU returns the next reduced axial state.
SPOGBAL and SPOSTATE establish the canonical returned state.
SPOXCONV records the component-wise raw map defect.
SPOLEAK writes L_next only after every preceding gate passes.
The complete returned state becomes the sole input to the next explicit block.

stored_denominators: max(max(abs(L_next)),max(abs(L_current))) with the existing exact-zero branch

step_contracts: Every radial and returned axial solve must reach its existing strict terminal condition without a cap.
The fixed basis, rank, state layout, normalization, geometry, materials, tracks, source identity and controls must remain unchanged.
The returned state must be finite and physically admissible under the existing positivity and source contracts.
Existing balance and Galerkin diagnostics are recorded separately and are not compared with a new threshold.
A failed or incomplete return is not x_next and may not drive another map block.
Trend relations are emitted only after all three returns and all four state archives are valid.

complete.label: CENSUS-COMPLETE-DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY

incomplete.label: CENSUS-INCOMPLETE-NO-SCIENTIFIC-RESULT
incomplete.requirements: Any identity, structure, strict-solve, finite-value, positivity, source, balance, Galerkin, process, timeout or record contract fails.

allowed: For a named component, state the two exact adjacent finite-trajectory relations.
Report whether the frozen map completed exactly three valid online returns.
Describe sign reversals only from the stored signed component arrays.
forbidden: Infer asymptotic behavior from three returns.
Fit a convergence rate, spectral radius or error model.
Attribute equality or reversal to binary32 arithmetic.
Combine a, rho and L into one weighted score.
Change rank, tolerance, acceleration, relaxation or physical inputs after seeing a return.
Use this diagnostic to repair or supersede the frozen Stage-4 classifications.
Call this Stage 5 or authorize any longer trajectory.
